MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition x RRP x access x panel_joints. Coating tasks use QT x access x panel_joints. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x beadboard(1.20) = 7.68x — extreme theoretical
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x solid_panel(1.0) = 2.03x — within cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.30) x scaffold(1.60) x beadboard(1.20) = 2.50x — within 4.0x cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x solid_panel(1.0) = 1.35x — comfortable

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x panel_joints)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x panel_joints)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough — no modifiers.

porch_ceiling_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net porch ceiling field area. ALL base rates include overhead work penalty (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines). Do NOT apply FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD as a stacking modifier. RP rates calibrated from NC sibling with RP-specific adjustments.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Floor Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_PRCH_FLOOR_PROTECT (250 SF/hr). Ground-level task. Canvas drop cloths on porch floor. RP: also catches scraping debris.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Furniture Cover/Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_PRCH_FURNITURE_PROTECT (8 EA/hr). ~7.5 min per item. Ground-level.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Ceiling Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_PRCH_FIXTURE_MASK (8 EA/hr). Ceiling fans ~10-15 min with blade removal, pendant lights ~5-8 min, recessed cans ~3-5 min. Average ~7.5 min. RP: all fixtures installed and operational.

task_production_rates.name: Fascia/Wall Junction Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_PRCH_FASCIA_MASK (500 SF/hr). Tape + film at junctions. RP: MANDATORY (fascia/wall almost always already finished).

task_production_rates.name: Adjacent Siding Masking (Spray Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Film + tape on siding at porch wall junction. ~9 sec per SF. Spray only. Rate from soffit RP siding masking pattern.

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (25 min). Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles, ladders.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (45 min). Configure airless sprayer. No vent verification needed.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Paint Screening
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. XRF or swab test. ~15 min per elevation.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. 6-mil poly 10 ft from structure. ~45 min per elevation.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Overhead wet scraping is very slow. ~72 sec per SF. Mist + scrape + collect.

task_production_rates.name: RRP HEPA Vacuum
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. HEPA vacuum surfaces and containment. ~18 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Remove poly, bag waste. ~30 min per elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Full visual scan overhead. ~20 min per porch section. Photograph defects, assign substrate state.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test — ASTM D3359
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Cross-hatch tape test. 2-3 locations per section. ~10 min per section.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Priority check for porch ceiling. Identify extent and severity. ~10 min per section.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Probe — Wood Panels
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Moisture meter at joints and roof penetrations. ~10 min per section. MC > 15% = stop work.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Condition Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. Check panel joints and junctions. ~10 min per section.

task_production_rates.name: Low-Pressure Wash Porch Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC TSK_PRCH_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE (350 SF/hr). Garden hose + soft brush + mildew detergent overhead. ~10 sec per SF. NEVER power wash.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Apply biocide solution overhead. ~18 sec per SF. Dwell time, then rinse. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical ~300 SF/hr). Same as soffit RP mildew treatment rate.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Residue Remediation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Stiff brush removal + detergent wash overhead. ~24 sec per SF. Required before chalk-binding primer. Same rate as soffit RP chalk remediation.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape and Feather Failing/Peeling Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Overhead scraping + feather sanding. ~60 sec per SF at GOOD baseline. SLOWEST exterior prep task — gravity works against tool stroke. Condition scale drives intensity: FAIR 1.5x, POOR 2.0x. RRP 2.0x stacks. Calibrated from soffit RP overhead scrape rate.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Sound Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. 150-grit scuff or chemical deglosser overhead. ~20 sec per SF. Same rate as NC TSK_PRCH_SAND_PREP_FC (175 SF/hr) — both are light scuff overhead. Panel joints modifier applies for T&G/beadboard groove scuffing.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Replacement at Panel Joints
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Same rate as NC TSK_PRCH_CAULK_JOINTS (55 LF/hr). Remove old caulk + apply + tool overhead. ~65 sec per LF. Apply after prime (COMPAT rule).

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_PRCH_DUST_CLEANUP (400 SF/hr). Tack cloth overhead. ~9 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: State-Driven Primer — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same base rate as NC TSK_PRCH_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (120 SF/hr). State-driven product selection: chalk-binding for chalking, acrylic stain-block for failing/peeling wood, alkali-resistant for failing/peeling FC. Spot or full prime based on condition.

task_production_rates.name: State-Driven Primer — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same base rate as NC TSK_PRCH_PRIME_SPRAY (250 SF/hr). Always eligible (no vent constraint). Spot or full prime based on condition.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC rates. Brush cut-in at fascia, wall, column junctions overhead.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (120 SF/hr). Roller + extension pole for field, brush for grooves. Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (250 SF/hr). Airless spray overhead. Always eligible.

task_production_rates.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (150 SF/hr). Brush into grooves while spray coat is wet. FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS does NOT apply (rate already reflects groove work).

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC rates. Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (175 SF/hr). 220-grit intercoat scuff overhead.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC rates. Brush touch-up overhead.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Dust Removal — QT4 Only
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (400 SF/hr). Tack cloth after intercoat sanding.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC rates. Second coat cut-in overhead.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (120 SF/hr). Final appearance coat.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (250 SF/hr). Final appearance coat.

task_production_rates.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (150 SF/hr). Final coat — all grooves fully coated. FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS NOT applied.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same QT rates as NC. RP includes condition verification.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same QT rates as NC. RP emphasis on blend quality at repair areas.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 350 SF/hr, RP 300 SF/hr — ~15% slower due to more protection to remove). Remove floor cloths, furniture covers, fixture masks, fascia/wall/siding masking. Restore furniture.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (30 min). Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush sprayer if used.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 20 min, RP 25 min). RP generates more debris from scraping. Collect debris, final porch walkthrough.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Walk completed porch ceiling with customer. Maintenance recommendations: annual mildew check, caulk inspection, mildew-resistant formulation.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work. Stacks on overhead-adjusted base rates.
factor_modifiers.applies_to: All overhead per-SF tasks (23 tasks). NOT applied to ground-level tasks (floor protect, furniture protect, equipment setup, cleanup) or FIXED assessment tasks.
factor_modifiers.notes: Porch ceilings are typically at 8-10 ft (ground or step ladder). Lower access than soffit.

factor_modifiers.name: T&G / Beadboard Joint Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: T&G and beadboard groove joints add time for brush work.
factor_modifiers.notes: Groove brush-back tasks NOT included (rate already reflects groove work). Reused from NC.

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale Prep Intensity Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Maps from substrate state to 3-level condition scale driving prep task intensity.
factor_modifiers.notes: PREP pool only. Never applies to coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: RRP Lead-Safe Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Doubles prep task duration when RRP is required (pre-1978 + lead-positive).
factor_modifiers.notes: PREP pool only. Binary gate. Never applies to coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Production Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Quality tier affects pace on qt_scaled tasks.
factor_modifiers.notes: COATING pool only. Never applies to prep tasks.

QT2.notes: Economy RP. Single finish. Minimal inspection.

QT3.notes: Standard RP. Two finish coats. Interstage inspection.

QT4.notes: Premium RP. Two coats. Intercoat sand 220-grit. Systematic inspection.

assumptions: Base rates include overhead penalty. Do NOT apply FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD as stacking modifier.
FAC_EXT_ACCESS and FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS stack multiplicatively on coating tasks.
FAC_CONDITION_SCALE and FAC_PCRP_RRP stack multiplicatively on prep tasks (separate pool from coating).
Spray always eligible — no vent constraint (key difference from soffit).
Groove brush-back tasks already reflect groove work — FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS NOT applied.
Assessment tasks are FIXED time — no modifiers.
RP protection teardown is ~15% slower than NC (more masking to remove).
Mildew biocide treatment rate calibrated from soffit RP (200 SF/hr overhead).
Scrape/feather is the highest-cost RP prep task — condition scale and RRP modifiers drive cost.
risks: Beadboard modifier (1.20x) assumed equal to T&G — may need field calibration.
Ceiling fan masking time varies significantly by fan complexity.
Overhead spray rates may need field calibration — limited data for porch ceiling spray RP.
Theoretical prep pool max (7.68x with RRP) exceeds 4.0x cap — recommend T&M for extreme cases.
